json_report.text_preview:
The Minister said the policy was “a considerable improvement” — though critics
disagreed.

Applicants who don’t provide evidence can’t be assessed; they’ll be written to
within 10 days.

The café’s naïve résumé policy affected 250 employees … or so it seemed.

“We must act,” she said, “and we must act now.”

The range is 10–20 per cent (see § 4.2). Temperatures reached 21 °C.

Ünlü, Müller and Añez co-authored the paper.
